transcript.text: I need to raise an operational constraint from engineering. While debugging an unrelated queue-consumer issue this morning, I measured that more than 2 concurrent inference requests can exhaust the triage worker's connection pool. When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label entirely. I have not yet filed this finding in the launch ticket. This means our rollout configuration must either cap concurrency at 2 inference requests or ensure the connection pool is sized appropriately before enablement, otherwise we risk tickets going unrouted in production.
